description: This PHP source file defines the UploadedFile class implementing the UploadedFileInterface, providing functionality to handle uploaded files, including moving the files, retrieving their stream, and managing errors.

classes.name: UploadedFile
classes.description: Represents an uploaded file, providing methods to access its properties, move it to a new location, and check for upload errors.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an UploadedFile instance with the provided stream, size, error status, filename, and media type.

methods.name: setStreamOrFile
methods.description: Sets the internal stream or file path based on the provided argument, throwing an exception if invalid.

methods.name: setError
methods.description: Validates and sets the upload error status.

methods.name: isOk
methods.description: Checks if the upload had no errors.

methods.name: isMoved
methods.description: Checks if the file has already been moved.

methods.name: validateActive
methods.description: Ensures the file is in a valid state for operations, throwing exceptions if not.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Retrieves the stream of the uploaded file, opening it if needed.

methods.name: moveTo
methods.description: Moves the uploaded file to the specified target path.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the uploaded file.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns the error code associated with the upload.

methods.name: getClientFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename provided by the client.

methods.name: getClientMediaType
methods.description: Returns the media type provided by the client.
